periods.description: Lux's public fighting style using Wyvern: evade, block, and endure without launching decisive attacks, resulting in undefeated but winless mock-battle records.

details.purpose_hidden: train observation and timing for Bahamut's Instant Strike
details.equipment: heavily armored Wyvern tuned to mimic Bahamut handling

activation.condition: Lux pilots Wyvern or similar Drag-Ride

effects: survives attacks far beyond ordinary Wyvern capacity
frustrates opponents by refusing to attack
builds perfect reading of enemy attack preparation

power_level.peak: endures Lisha's Tiamat attacks long enough to force fatigue

known_feats: never loses official mock battles but never wins
withstands Divine Drag-Ride pressure with damaged Wyvern
